title: Reproductive system
audience: a medical student in the preclinical years
prerequisites: M1, M2, M3, M8; helpful: S5.
purpose: Integrate reproductive anatomy and development, sexual differentiation, male reproduction, the menstrual cycle, fertility and contraception, pregnancy and its complications, labor, gynecologic infections and tumors, breast disease and reproductive drugs.

weeks.9: Gynecologic infections and sexually transmitted infections

blocks.deliverable: Explain the hormonal control of sexual differentiation.
Draw the hormonal changes of the menstrual cycle.
Compare contraceptive methods by mechanism and effectiveness.
Week 7 midterm; recognize preeclampsia and its severe features.
Choose tests and treatment for vaginitis.
Outline the workup of a breast mass.
Submit the project; take an unseen 150 minute final in week 14.

project: Reproductive health counseling brief: compare contraceptive methods by mechanism, effectiveness and contraindications, and outline routine prenatal screening.
completion: finish the project, take the week 7 midterm and week 14 cumulative final, then complete a new cumulative assessment after 1 to 2 weeks. Explain one major idea aloud without notes.
